newsitem.title: USA: Tornadoes hit Tennessee, one feared dead.
newsitem.headline: Tornadoes hit Tennessee, one feared dead.

text.p: One person was feared dead and 20,000 were without power after as many as 11 tornadoes touched down in Tennessee late Friday and early Saturday, a spokesman for the state's Emergency Management Agency said.

"We had reports of one fatality but that has not been confirmed," said Tom Womack, acting spokesman for the emergency agency. "As many as 50 people were hospitalized, 19 to 20 are still in the hospital and at least two are in critical condition."

The worst damage was reported near Chattanooga where a tornado cut a mile-wide swath through the city and suburbs and struck two apartment complexes housing about 3,000 people. The fatality was reported in the Chattanooga suburb of East Brainerd, Womack said.
At least 60 people sought emergency shelter overnight and about 20,000 were without power early Saturday, he said.
"As far as we can determine, a single tornado touched down in East Brainerd and apparently travelled about eight miles with the width of the damage being one mile wide," Womack said.
Emergency officials are now assessing the damage before they decide if federal assistance is requested, he said.
Tornadoes also touched down in Kentucky overnight, killing at least one person and causing widespread property damage.
Meteorologists said the worst weather had passed and forecasts called for only isolated storms across Kentucky Sunday.
